ns2:section.sectionText: . This is an experiential course focusing on investment analysis in the context of the investment community. The course will help students generate superior investment ideas by conducting creative, value-added research. Students will act as hedge fund analysts by working through the investment process: idea generation, analysis, and presentation, and should walk away with a working knowledge of the hedge fund industry. Student teams will present a series of both long and short ideas to both the professor and to the class. Because the simulation will mimic an actual presentation in a hedge fund environment, students will also learn the terminology associated with communicating to portfolio managers and other analysts. Students will learn to answer questions directed at them by investment peers, and will be challenged to learn to think quickly on their feet and effectively justify their positions. In short, the goal of the course is to leave you prepared for your interviews in the investment management industry. - - Please note this course serves as the mandatory prerequisite for Portfolio Management, FIN 580PM, where students will utilize StockTrak, a virtual stock market application, to manage portfolios consisting of stocks and derivatives. Registration restricted to MSF students only.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: Finance Cost Rec -UIUC or MBA:Bus Administration -UIUC.
